en: Colorized vintage street view of a large corner hotel building labeled "Hotel Petersburg." The scene shows a two‑story structure with a gabled central section, many windows, and a green roof. Signs in both Russian and German cover the facade, advertising the hotel and a wine shop. Several horse‑drawn carriages stand in front, and numerous people—men, women, and children in early 20th‑century clothing—are gathered in the cobbled street. The caption at the upper left reads "Libau - Hotel Petersburg."
